environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instance (t3.medium) running in AWS VPC. Instance has IAM role with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) is enabled. No network egress filtering. AppArmor is installed but in complain mode (aa-complain). The application runs as the 'deploy' user with standard filesystem access. Security groups allow all outbound traffic.
